ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.dps_ttm_basis: sum of the four quarterly DPS facts 2025-11-08..2026-08-15
dividends.frequency_basis: spacing of the latest 4 positive quarterly DPS facts (2025-11-08, 2026-01-31, 2026-05-23, 2026-08-15); the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-11-08..2026-08-15
dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters filed); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-11-08..2026-08-15

dividend_yield.basis: sum of the four quarterly DPS facts 2025-11-08..2026-08-15

dividend_yield.note: sum of the four quarterly DPS facts 2025-11-08..2026-08-15
